**Test image observations:**
- Tomato leaf showing extensive interveinal chlorosis (yellow between veins, green veins retained)
- Distinct vein network clearly visible against pale yellow background
- Brown necrotic lesion on lower-left margin
- No powdery coating, no distinct circular spots, leaf is flat (not curled)

Top candidates: **Leaf_Mold** (yellow patches on upper surface with green veins), **Verticillium_Wilt** (interveinal yellowing + necrosis)

Let me view the Leaf_Mold reference to confirm.

The Leaf_Mold reference (bottom-right panel especially) shows the same distinctive pattern: interveinal chlorosis with the green vein network highlighted against a pale yellow background — exactly matching the test image. The brown necrotic margin area also aligns with advanced Leaf_Mold lesions.
